architecture: MobileNetV2 Transfer Learning with GlobalAveragePooling and Dense Head

class_names.2: High DME Risk Category (Hard Exudates within 1 Disc Diameter of Foveal Center)

class_descriptions.0: No apparent hard exudates within the macular boundary.
class_descriptions.1: Hard exudates present within macular region, but > 1 disc diameter from the foveal center per IDRiD criteria.
class_descriptions.2: Hard exudates present within 1 disc diameter of the foveal center per IDRiD criteria (High Risk category; requires clinical ophthalmological examination and OCT confirmation).
